title: Boss Challenge: Fire Safety Officer
summary: Use the fire triangle to handle six real emergencies: oil fires, electrical fires, clothes on fire, petrol fires and gas leaks.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: applying knowledge in real situations (Criteria A and D)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 5: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical (conditions for combustion, putting out a fire)
Earlier NCERT Class 8 Ch 6: Combustion and Flame (how do we control fire?)

objectives: I can choose the safest way to deal with different types of fire, using the fire triangle.
I can explain why water must not be used on oil, petrol or electrical fires.
I can describe what to do if there is an LPG leak.
misconceptions: Water puts out every kind of fire.
If your clothes catch fire, you should run for help.
Switching on a light helps you find a gas leak.
